en.title: Ischgl next week: steady snow, about 18 cm up high (forecast 23–29 November 2026)
en.description: Ischgl snow forecast for 23–29 November 2026: 18 cm at the top (3–34 cm), 14 cm at the base, snowiest day Thursday 26 November, with neighbours compared.
en.lede: After a modest start this week (16 cm at the top from 17 to 20 November), Ischgl lines up another round. Next week, 23 to 29 November, brings 18 cm up high in the middle of our forecast, anywhere from 3 to 34 cm, and 14 cm at the base.

sections.h: Where the good snow will be
p: The snowiest day up top is Thursday 26 November, with 5 cm in the middle of our forecast (up to 10 cm). That is a fresh coat on the groomers, nothing more.

Where to look in Ischgl: the high bowls towards Samnaun, which keep their snow cold. The snow-sure top is the Idalp plateau, Greitspitz and Palinkopf; the part to treat with caution is Ischgl village down in the Paznaun valley.

sections.h: How the week of 23–29 November adds up in Ischgl
p: At the top (around 2700 m) the week totals 18 cm, 3–34 cm across our range. Mid-mountain around 2100 m gets 17 cm (2–31 cm), and the base around 1500 m 14 cm (2–26 cm).

Day by day, the upper mountain picks up most of it on Monday 23 (3 cm, up to 4), Wednesday 25 (3 cm, up to 6), Thursday 26 (5 cm, up to 10) and Sunday 29 (5 cm, up to 10). Outside those days expect little more than flurries.
The first instalment comes this week: 16 cm on the upper slopes of Ischgl from 17 to 20 November, 10 cm lower down. Next week adds a second layer on top.
Little is lost on the way down: 14 cm around 1500 m against 18 cm up high. On these numbers the precipitation falls as snow almost everywhere in Ischgl.
Ischgl's terrain starts high above the village, so the skiing reached from the Idalp is a different climate.

sections.h: Is Ischgl the best bet nearby?
p: For comparison, the upper slopes of the closest big resorts collect St. Anton (19 km away) 25 cm, Lech-Zürs (29 km away) 30 cm and Davos (40 km away) 16 cm; Ischgl sits at 18 cm.
So Lech-Zürs is the better bet for fresh snow next week, if you are free to choose.
Not very. The high case gives 34 cm up top, the low case just 3 cm, so whether Ischgl gets a real fall depends on a storm track that is still undecided.
Storm timing tends to firm up first; totals keep moving until a day or two before.

advice: Before leaving the pistes in Ischgl, check the regional avalanche service of the province.
Opening dates are the resort's call; our numbers only say how much snow is coming.
Watch the forecast midweek: the top's range is 3–34 cm.
